definitions.gloss: sharp decrease; dramatic drop; drastic reduction
definitions.explanation: A sudden and significant decrease in number, quantity, or amount.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}が{激減|げきげん}した。
{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{激減|げきげん}して{地域|ちいき}{経済|けいざい}に{影響|えいきょう}が{出|で}ている。
examples.english: The sharp decline in tourists is affecting the local economy.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{規制|きせい}の{導入|どうにゅう}により、{違反件数|いはんけんすう}が{前年比|ぜんねんひ}で{激減|げきげん}した。
examples.english: Due to the introduction of new regulations, the number of violations dropped dramatically compared to the previous year.

notes:
FORMATION: {激|げき} (intense, extreme) + {減|げん} (decrease). The prefix {激|げき} intensifies the degree of change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人口|じんこう}が{激減|げきげん}する: population drops sharply
- {収入|しゅうにゅう}が{激減|げきげん}する: income decreases drastically
- {激減|げきげん}の{原因|げんいん}: cause of the sharp decline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {激減|げきげん}: dramatic decrease (emphasizes severity)
- {減少|げんしょう}: decrease (neutral, general term)
- {急減|きゅうげん}: rapid decrease (emphasizes speed)
- {激増|げきぞう}: dramatic increase (antonym)
